kicker: AI AT WORK · PARETO OF LATE ORDERS
title: Find the *two* reasons behind late orders
subtitle: Reason share = late with that reason ÷ all late. Illustrative numbers.
prompt:
Group these late orders by reason,
lane and DC. Rank the reasons by share
and show the maths. Flag any reason
that grew vs last week. Data: [paste export]
tip: A few causes create most misses. AI sorts them, your team owns the actions.
warn: If Other or blank is above 10%, fix the reason codes first. Strip customer names.
